mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_card ORDER BY display_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_card (card_name, owner_code, card_type, account_id, payment_day, status) VALUES (#{cardName}, #{ownerCode}, #{cardType}, #{accountId}, #{paymentDay}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_card SET card_name=#{cardName}, owner_code=#{ownerCode}, card_type=#{cardType}, account_id=#{accountId}, payment_day=#{paymentDay}, status=#{status}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
